macros.name: thumbyBackground
macros.doc: The background color of each thumb index.

macros.name: thumbyForeground
macros.doc: The foreground color of each thumb index.

macros.name: thumbyPageHeight
macros.doc: The height of each page, in points.

macros.name: thumbySetup
macros.doc: This command must follow the rest of the \thumby commands. It will use the values provided by the other commands to make all calculations necessary for Thumby to do its magic.

macros.name: thumbyThumbWidth
macros.doc: The width of each thumb index, in points.

macros.name: thumbyTotalChapters
macros.doc: The total number of chapters in your document. Thumby will divide the page height by the total number of chapters to get the height of each thumb index.
